items.title: Ulta Beauty Slips 4% Despite Raised Guidance and Q2 Earnings Beat, e.l.f. Beauty Pulls Back
items.summary: Ulta Beauty posted a clean earnings beat and raised its full year outlook, yet traders punished the stock in heavy Friday volume. Understanding why requires a closer look at the pattern that has haunted this name after nearly every strong report.

items.summary: The US speciality beauty retailer now expects net sales growth of 6.7% to 7.2% for the full year, compared with its previous forecast of 6% to 7%.

items.title: Ulta leans into exclusivity amid Target Beauty Studio competition

items.title: Ulta Beauty beats Q2 estimates and raises fiscal 2026 guidance
items.summary: Ulta Beauty Inc (NASDAQ:ULTA) reported second-quarter earnings and revenue above analyst expectations, while the beauty retailer also raised its fiscal 2026 guidance. The company posted adjusted earnings per share of $6.

items.title: Ulta Beauty Stock Falls After Upbeat Earnings
items.summary: Ulta Beauty’s  shares have been more like an eyesore this year and they were falling in the Friday premarket.  Ulta said it earned $6.55 a share in its fiscal second quarter, on revenue that rose nearly 9% year over year, to $3.04 billion.  Analysts were looking for earnings per share of $6.20 on revenue of $2.99 billion.
